blockers.title: GitHub autonomous merge and required-check authority is not established
blockers.description: AGENTS.md reserves repository security settings and main merges for explicit owner authorization. The active Protect Main Branch ruleset currently enforces deletion and non-fast-forward protections only. The classic branch-protection endpoint is not readable through the current integration, so required PR approvals and status checks remain unverified. PR-based integration is available; ruleset/branch-protection changes and unattended main merge require owner action.
blockers.next_step: Owner reviews GitHub Settings for main, configures required PR approvals/status checks and up-to-date branches, then explicitly authorizes main integration. Keep PR-based integration meanwhile.

blockers.title: Decision-grade M3 evaluation lacks a qualifying zero-cost model and protected hidden-oracle path
blockers.description: M3-000 topology and runtime isolation are complete. M3-003 completed its locked six-cell CPU feasibility evaluation on three pinned Granite tiers and two schema-disclosure arms; all six trials failed before the full inspect/propose/validate/plan lifecycle, so no model qualifies. M3-004 addresses a harness limitation found in provider telemetry: the model receives only one generic agent.invoke function schema while discovered Gateway schemas are carried as conversational state. M3-001 remains blocked until a qualifying zero-cost model path and protected evaluator-only hidden-oracle custody are both verified. No paid API/GPU spend is authorized.
blockers.next_step: Complete M3-004 by exposing exact Gateway schemas as provider-native functions, then rerun the locked CPU matrix. In parallel, prepare the protected m3-evaluator Environment and evaluator-only oracle custody; do not dispatch the hidden-oracle cohort until both gates pass.
